name: U-shaped staircase
notes: Rise 3.0 m, 16 risers: eleven up to a half landing along -Z, five back along +Z. Two 1.0 m flights with a 0.1 m well. Size Y is the bounding height including newels above the upper floor.
parts: eleven risers and ten oak treads to a half landing
oak landing platform 2.1 x 1.0 m on rim beams with fascia and baseboard
five risers climbing back to the upper floor
wall skirt stringers on the outer sides, cut stringers on the well side
turned balusters and oak handrails on the well side of both flights
corner newel carried to the floor, foot and top newels with ball finials
style: colonial staircase, oak treads, white risers and balusters
summary: U-shaped staircase, 16 risers, 3.0 m rise, half landing: oak treads and landing, painted risers, wall and cut stringers, balusters, handrail.
